rationale.metric: ROC AUC is robust and standard for binary conversion prediction with 31 percent positive class.
rationale.drop_columns: No high-cardinality IDs, datetimes, or text columns are present in the features.
rationale.preprocessing: Median imputation and standard scaling for numericals, with one-hot encoding for categoricals.
rationale.feature_selection: Keeping all features since the dataset has a very small feature set of only 9 predictors.
rationale.model: Hist gradient boosting effectively captures non-linear interactions across mixed tabular feature types.
rationale.class_weight: Balanced class weighting accounts for the moderate conversion class imbalance.
